verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a registry service, since a registry could expose a transactional API for programmatic filings. The evidence documents only the web-based Online Filing Centre and a PDF email/mail fallback. The probe states the registry "documents no transactional API on any surface checked." The keyless CKAN API answers on open.canada.ca, the national open-data layer, which is a separate host-platform capability and not the product's own automation surface, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
